_interval_note: Web JSON uses intervals (not hotspots). Sorted by min_BH_q. concentration = n_spliceogenic in interval / n_spliceogenic_interior in that intron. top_in_intron marks the best-q interval per intron.

variants._note: spliceogenic_variants.csv already keeps High (>=1.0) and Moderate (>=0.56). min_score 0.56 matches that floor.

_gtf_note: Leave null. Exons come from refseq + transcript.json; intron bounds from *_introns.tsv.
_refseq_note: UCSC ncbiRefSeq table used for the screen. Exons are taken from the scored transcript id in transcript.json.
_disease_genes_note: OMIM disease-gene list used to drive the screen; packed into summary_tables zip.

release.title: Genome-wide deep-intronic splice hotspot atlas of OMIM disease-associated genes
